items.title: Sustainability trends and gaps in the textile, apparel and fashion industries - PMC
items.content: As a result, stakeholders are becoming more aware of the effect of the textile, apparel, and fashion industries on the climate and human rights, thus pushing businesses to mitigate their environmental damage. This paper offers a systematic literature review of sustainability trends in the TAF industries in the last 20 years.

items.title: How can we make textile and garment production sustainable? | World Economic Forum
items.content: Making the textile and garment industry more sustainable is critical for global efforts to decarbonize supply chains and curb greenhouse gas emissions.
